text:
alex: Quick sync — we need to decide if Embeddings Cache is in MVP or pushed to v1. Customer pilot (SearchPilot) asked for cross-request hits to cut embedding costs by ~40% on their workload.

maria: Can we scope a cheap MVP that still gives most wins?

sam: Two options: 1) local LRU per worker (fast, no infra) — modest hit rates for multi-tenant traffic. 2) shared Redis-style cache (cross-worker hits, higher ops + infra cost, network overhead).

lin: Important: Private/Dedicated customers can't always rely on shared Redis unless we ship a deployable infra option. That pushes complexity for Private.

alex: Yeah. Tradeoffs: local LRU = low infra risk, works with Dedicated/Private immediately, but hit rate depends on request locality. Shared cache = ~+30% hit improvement on pilot, but needs config, HA, auth, and costs.

maria: What are the numbers? Sam, can you paste the pilot numbers?

sam: Pilot snapshot:
```
workload: SearchPilot
baseline embedding qps: 120 rps
per-request embeddings per session: 3
observed cross-session similarity -> potential shareable embeddings: 42%
estimated cost reduction if shared cache: 38% +/- 5%
```

lin: Also note p99 latency with shared cache + network hop adds ~6-12ms on avg (depends on region). Local LRU has near-zero added latency.

alex: Ok. Proposal: for MVP include the local in-process LRU with configurable size + telemetry so we can measure hit rate and savings. If pilot metrics cross thresholds (hit_rate >= 30% and cost_reduction >= 25%) within 2 weeks, we fast-track shared cache as an opt-in v1 rollout.

maria: That seems conservative and lowers launch risk. What are the launch criteria we can commit to for MVP?

alex: MVP launch criteria proposal:
- Implement LRU cache per worker (config: `LRU_SIZE`, `TTL`)
- Emit metrics: `emb.cache.hit_rate`, `emb.cache.local_hits`, `emb.cache.remote_hits` (if any)
- Observe end-to-end request latency p50/p95 within current SLO +/- 5%
- Integration test + canary on Hosted (10% traffic) with feature flag

sam: I'll add a short config snippet for the LRU defaults: 
```
LRU_SIZE=20000  # entries per worker
TTL=24h
ENABLE_LOCAL_CACHE=true
```

lin: For Private: default to ENABLE_LOCAL_CACHE=true. Shared cache option requires network policy docs and infra ticket.

maria: Timeline impact? If we accept local-LRU MVP we can keep the milestone date. Shared cache as v1 will be a separate sprint + infra.

alex: Action items: 
- sam: implement LRU + metrics + canary plan — 2w
- lin: doc Private/Dedicated implications + infra ticket for shared cache — 1w
- maria: update milestone tracker and customer comms with option plan — 1w

sam: noted. I'll instrument metrics so we can evaluate the pilot in realtime. ops-bot, can you schedule a canary rollout window for next Tue 10:00 PDT?

ops-bot: Canary window scheduled: Tue 10:00 PDT -> Tue 13:00 PDT. Notifying infra oncall.

alex: Cool. Decision: Embeddings Cache goes into MVP as local LRU with telemetry. Shared global cache moved to v1 opt-in pending pilot signals. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the roadmap slice and notify SearchPilot about phased approach.

sam: Quick note — if we see >50% shareable embeddings early we should sesh and reprioritize shared cache sooner.

lin: Agreed. Will keep infra options ready.

alex: Thanks all — will file the PRD update and link it here.

maria: Ping when PRD is up.
